\section{Project Timeline}
\label{sec:timeline}

Figure~\ref{fig:timeline} shows the timeline of the project from mid-June to early October 2026, with the member responsible for each task. The work went through four overlapping phases: analysis and design until early August, implementation from late July to late September, testing and deployment in September, and the report from late August. After both members agreed on the shared pipeline and the interface of the search block in July, the two parts were developed in parallel; the work of each member is listed on the Work Contribution page. The two milestones marked on the figure are the mid-term review on 10 August and the submission of the report on 30 September.
